proposed.text: Nebula and Mantis meet on Ego's planet, where Mantis tells her and Gamora about Ego's dead children. They then fight on the same side against Ego.

changes.evidence: In Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2, Ego brings Mantis to Quill, Gamora and Drax on Berhert while Nebula is held prisoner on the Milano. Nebula first meets Mantis later on Ego's planet, when she and Gamora burst in on her and Mantis reveals the bodies of Ego's children.

changes.evidence: In 'The Dirty Half Dozen' (S2 E19) Hill calls Coulson, who gives her the intel on the scepter held at the Hydra base in Sokovia and tells her to assemble the Avengers. After Hill urged him in S1 E20 to cut ties with S.H.I.E.L.D., this is a renewed working alliance with Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D., and it leads to the raid in Avengers: Age of Ultron.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Now fellow Guardians on Knowhere, Kraglin accidentally stabs Nebula while practicing with Yondu's arrow. During the rescue from the High Evolutionary, she has him lock Knowhere onto the enemy ship so the team can escape.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian, whom Kraglin stabs by accident with Yondu's arrow.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian, who stabs Nebula by accident with Yondu's arrow.

changes.evidence: The only stage is Vol. 2, where Kraglin gives Nebula a hand and a ship to go and kill Gamora. By Vol. 3 they are teammates on Knowhere: his arrow practice stabs her in the chest, and in the climax Nebula radios him to interlock Knowhere with Arete Laboratories so the Guardians can escape.
